newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 19.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 19.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A 30 millimetre helicopter machine-gun bullet, found in a laystall near the Kaposvar NATO base, was lost by the American army.

- The junior ruling coalition member Free Democrats said it was already part of the election capmpaign that four opposition parties began to collect signatures to support a referendum on the new law on land, which the opposition parties said should not allow foreigners to buy Hungarian land.
- A Hungarian-born U.S. businessman plans to set up a Christian-spirit television channel in Hungary.
